hypothesis: For physical experimental trials, the measured temporal shape of the input carries predictive information about the final three-bit state beyond initial state and nominal static forcing descriptors.
seen_data: published qualitative article information and public dataset metadata only
raw experimental archive exp.zip not opened by ORI-C before this package
forbidden_or_hidden_data: trial-level experimental values in exp.zip until the frozen package is committed publicly
predicted_variable: exact-match accuracy of final three-bit state
prediction: X+H exact-match accuracy improves by at least 10 percentage points over X-only
competitor: X-only and same-complexity H permuted within initial-state strata
success: gain >= 10 percentage points, bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 and H-permutation p <= 0.05
failure: gain < 10 percentage points or bootstrap lower bound <= 0 or permutation p > 0.05
blindness_rule: do not open exp.zip before an explicit public registration URL and timestamp exist if the result is to be treated as prospectively registered
